title: Context Multiplexing & Reducers
overview: Model complex UI workflows using deterministic state machines and pure reducer functions.
Implement time-travel debugging and action audit logs.

takeaways.title: Pure Reducer Contracts
takeaways.desc: Keep reducers synchronous and side-effect free; dispatch outcomes explicitly.

takeaways.title: Action Namespacing
takeaways.desc: Prefix action types with feature domains to avoid cross-module collision.
